messages:
Maya (CSM): Heads-up: Atlaswell hit 429s during QA for their EU pilot. They want a temporary throughput bump + proxy allowlist for the demo on 2026-06-10 10:00-13:00 UTC. Renewal check in 7 days; this demo matters.
Atlaswell Ops (customer): Confirming egress CIDRs: 203.0.113.32/28 and 198.51.100.192/29. Expect ~3x baseline burst for 3h. We can enable client backoff if needed.
Ren (Edge Eng): Are they using the hosted eu gateway via our proxy? Which endpoints?
Maya (CSM): Hosted API through eu gateway, streaming text completions. Not on Dedicated.
Theo (SRE): Plan: temp QPS override for the window, add CIDR ACL, auto-revoke after 6h, monitoring alarms and fallback routing. Any tradeoffs?
Maya (CSM): Auto-revoke 6h OK. I'll update the customer and note rollback plan.
Ren (Edge Eng): Staging config I'll apply:
route: eu-west-1
allow_cidrs:
  - 203.0.113.32/28
  - 198.51.100.192/29
qps_override: 3x
auto_revoke: 6h
apply_before: 10m
ETA to stage ~20m.
OpsBot: Ticket CS-11422 created (owner: Ren)	6 temporary EU allowlist + QPS lift. Scheduled window: 2026-06-10 10:00-13:00 UTC. Auto-revoke: 6h.
Theo (SRE): I'll run capacity sim and enable fallback to eu-fallback-2 if latency degrades. Adding alert: route_queue >60% or 5xx >0.5% pages.
Atlaswell Ops (customer): Sarah will be oncall (sarah@atlaswell.io). We'll enable exponential backoff on client.
Ren (Edge Eng): Staged and validated in staging (sim load test). Ready to apply to prod 10m before window.
Theo (SRE): Capacity looks OK for 3x for 3h with fallback. Runbook created and alarm armed.
Maya (CSM): I'll note in renewal: successful demo ops reduces churn risk; follow-up SOW if they scale. Will send runbook to Sarah.
Ren (Edge Eng): Applied in prod, configs live, monitoring green.
Theo (SRE): Watching metrics. No anomalies so far.
Maya (CSM): Closing pre-demo loop. After-action thread pending to capture customer feedback and next steps. :thumbsup:
